name: wraptool connect
description: Wire a dev container to a host-side wraptool MCP server (credential-isolated CLI tools). Image-agnostic: adds no tools of its own, only the MCP connection config. Auto-detects the host via the container's default-route gateway.

harness.description: Which MCP client config to write: claude (Claude Code, .mcp.json, SSE) or agy (Antigravity, .agents/mcp_config.json, Streamable HTTP /mcp). More harnesses to follow.

port.description: Host wraptool port, used when the URL is auto-detected.

url.description: Explicit wraptool base URL (e.g. http://172.18.0.1:8717). Empty = auto-detect the host as the container's default-route gateway.
